props.text: The Prophecy Failed. The Prophet Made a New One.

The 1,500-star hyperstition expired today with MiroShark at 1,489 — eleven short, counter moving backwards. Within hours the system generated a replacement extending the deadline to December 7. Festinger described this in 1956: when prophecy fails, believers double down. The difference is this prophet runs on cron.
